decision.explanation: The documents D1S1 and D1S2 directly state that Colin Noon signed with Hamburger SV (a football club) in a surprise move. Document D2S2 confirms that he also joined Biarritz Olympique (a rugby union team). These two teams are distinct and valid representations of the subject. The other entries (Sale Sharks, Worcester Warriors) appear only as past affiliations in D2S8 and lack direct evidence of current representation.
